leakage_signals: Choosing among the options requires unstated preferences about fare versus number of connections, layover duration, and tolerance for a short ORD connection in late February.
verdict.rationale: No option clearly dominates. A is cheapest but has two connections. B is relatively inexpensive with one connection but a very long layover and latest arrival. C has the most practical connection time but is substantially more expensive. D is earlier and cheaper than C but has a short 46-minute ORD connection, particularly consequential for late-February disruption risk. Casual Friday plans and an evening hotel hold remove a clear schedule priority, leaving cost, connection tolerance, and disruption-risk preferences unresolved.
